reviews.text: Thank you so much for Ginger ! Red rose pit bull

I can’t recommend Dr. Mauldin enough! He has cared for all of my dogs over the years, and I’ve always felt like they are genuinely in the best hands with him. One of the things I appreciate most is how accommodating he is when something unexpected happens. There have been times when one of my dogs has gotten sick and needed to be seen as soon as possible, and he has gone out of his way to get us a same-day appointment.

He is knowledgeable, compassionate, and truly cares about his patients. Having a vet I can trust when one of my dogs isn’t feeling well means so much to me. I’m so grateful to have found such a wonderful veterinarian for my whole pack! 🐾❤️

I love this place and the staff:) they are respectful, reasonably priced, and don’t push for unnecessary treatments.
My family briefly tried a different vet office because we moved across town, we now make the drive back to Churchill vet because they are the best!

I’ve given a review before. But it warrants another. There is no other. He and his staff are beyond spectacular. He goes above and beyond what is necessary and cares so much. He never does anything unnecessary and there aren’t many docs out there today like this wonderful man!!!!!  Just wish he was a human dr. Haha.

Dr. Mauldin was my Wilfred’s vet from newborn to his tragic passing at 14yo.  Wilfred was my ride or die. My constant sidekick. He’d seen Dr. Mauldin two days prior to his passing for his well visit. After his passing, I never received any sort of condolences whatsoever from his office. The doctor made a brief appearance and that was it. I called about three weeks later bc of a charge they’d put on his cremation services (I discovered that they up charge significantly for this service), and at that time I shared my concerns with Melissa who said she’d pass these on to Dr. Mauldin. I’ve waited all this time to hear back from him and there’s been zero response other than the refunded charge.

It’s been heartbreaking. ❤️‍🩹 We won’t be using this vet clinic any longer for Izzy the cat or for my next sidekick. The lack of concern or care is just appalling.

I truly believe you won't find a better vet anywhere in San Antonio. This practice has always been extremely helpful, fair with pricing, and focused more on the animals than on profit. Our little dachshund passed away at a time that Churchill was closed, after gross negligence by a so-called "emergency after-hours vet." Even though it wasn't their fault at all, Churchill's staff took the time to reach out to us with condolences that our dog had passed away. That gesture was amazing, and says a lot about the doctor and the practice. I cannot recommend them enough.
They are very friendly on time and reasonable

I brought my 19-year-old cat in for a wellness check and flea treatment, and Dr. Mauldin delivered exceptional care. He was attentive, thoughtful, and proactive, offering helpful, practical recommendations to support my cat’s arthritis and overall comfort. I truly appreciated his compassionate approach and expertise, which made a meaningful difference in my cat’s care. Also, Darcy, Dr. Mauldin’s vet tech, was extremely helpful and gentle with my cat. This is the same level of care our dog receives during her appointments. I highly recommend Churchill Veterinary Hospital & Dental Clinic for anyone who wants and expects exceptional veterinarian care for their pets.
Great staff!
Great place for pets! The doctor and his aides are amazing!
Took my puppy for her visit yesterday and it went fantastic. Dr. Mauldin and his entire team were very professional, courteous, and very pleasant to work with. Highly recommend!

Dr Maudlin is one of the best vets in the San Antonio area.
Every Churchill staff member I have dealt with has given my family excellent and compassionate service.   I highly recommend Dr Maudlin and Churchill Veterinary Hospital!
Great experience with two visits and great prices
The staff and doc are very friendly, caring and professional. Always a great experience taking my pup here. Thank you!

I have been going to Dr Mauldin for almost 20 years.  He was the only Vet that would see my lil girl’s cat named Garfield one morning when he came home with half his ear hanging off from a fight. That was almost 20 years ago and we recently had to put that cat down by Dr Mauldin. Ever since that day - Dr Mauldin has treated 2 other dogs and another cat up until they died. This guy even offered to come to my house when I was ready to put down a very large dog named Jackson that had gotten old. When Jackson died at home on a Friday night - we were able to bring him to the clinic on a Saturday morning to arrange cremation services for him. We had another lil Jack Russel that needed surgery one time and also had to be put down due to old age. If your looking for a Vet to take care of your families pets - Dr Mauldin will not disappoint you. The staff has always been really friendly and helpful too. We had 2 dogs and a cat have cremation services arranged by this clinic. We only have one dog left from this pack of animals - and she will no doubt continue to see Dr Mauldin until she is reunited with her pack one day. Almost 20 years of various types of animal care from this man and I don’t have a single negative thing to say. He is the best in his profession.
Churchill Vet has been our go to for animal care for me than 20 years.  They are great and care as much we do about the care of our loved pets.
Feel so fortunate to have found this vet and his veterinary hospital.  Staff is always responsive and helful. Highly recommend!
Dr Mauldin is nice and honest. I wouldn't go anywhere else. The staff is wonderful too. Reasonably priced and still vet owned.

September 30, 2025

Definitely, one of the best veterinary doctors and hospital in the San Antonio area.

I took my little six pound chihuahua to this place this morning so the staff and the doctor could perform an annual checkup.
For her, the checkup entailed a dental cleaning, annual shots and all the other things you can get done while the animal is  sedated.

I've added a picture of the view from across  the street.

Looking forward to getting my little six pound chihuahua, back and hope that should you need a veterinarian you consider this business for your needs.

July 3, 2025
I needed to revisit the vet for my pet because she was experiencing a foul smell in her mouth.

I've been with this veterinary doctor for more than 20 years. He and his staff do a great job and very customer service oriented and professional.

I highly recommend him for anybody in the Blanco Rd and West Avenue or surrounding area.

November 2024
Great place to get your your pet care needs  addressed.

The doctor has been at this clinic for many years.  He's very good technically, he's compassionate and he's very good with all animals.

His staff is very attentive, professional and customer oriented.  I can't say enough about Churchill Veterinary Hospital. I've used them for more than 20 years and have had nothing but great service.

I hope you give them a try and your experiences are as good as mine has been.

Dr. Mauldin is the absolute best veterinarian! He's smart, truly knows veterinary medicine, calm, and gentle with our pets. His staff is also warm and responsive when we have questions. Veterinary hospitals understandably, don't seem to have the capacity to work pets in same day when there are emergencies or concerns, and will often refer out to emergency clinics. Churchill Vet Hospital will work our pets in on the same day, as long as it's within their working hours, which is so appreciated, even though I know they are also extremely busy! Very grateful to Dr. Mauldin and staff!
The staff and Dr. Mauldin are great! We have been going here for many years.
Dr. Jeff and his staff are amazing
We have been taking our pets to Dr. Mauldin and the Churchill Vet clan for over a decade. Maybe over 2 decades? They are the greatest!
Dr Mauldin is the best in Bexar county! My dog, Jenny, always leaves with a wag in her tail and pep in her step.
The Dr is very pleasant and is wonderful with my wild Aussie.  The assistants are very helpful.

Dr. Mauldin is a wonderful vet. He provides excellent service, is down to earth, flexible, and very reasonable in the cost of his services. His staff is very friendly and welcoming.
On a side note: We need more medical providers like Dr. Mauldin, who care more about their patients and their families, then about acquiring wealth.

I’ve been taking my dogs here for 15 years and couldn’t be happier. I first heard about Dr. Mauldin from my aunt, uncle, and grandma. They all took their dogs to him for years, so I figured I’d gum him a try.
I’ve moved out of town & all over over the years and kept Churchill Vet Hospital as my dog’s vet. I currently live in new Braunfels and still make the drive as it is worth it. No price gouging or insane fees like a lot of others.
Dr. Mauldin is incredibly intelligent, honest, and advises you on what he would do if your dog was his. I really appreciate this.
If anyone knew how I felt about my dogs, me saying that I trust him with their lives is huge. His office staff has always been just as pleasant. And of course, cute office cats!

honestly one of the best vet i’ve been too. had some bad experiences with past vets but everyone is very welcoming. Prices for a checkup/teeth extraction were very good i thought id be paying an arm and a leg! Dr Mauldin handled my dog with care and was very straight to the point. Will definitely be coming back.

I really love this vet and office, they’ve allowed us to come in late notice when we’ve had emergencies and have also taken great care of our pets for their yearly appointments. The vet is very friendly as are his techs and the staff in the front! The pricing is fair, really recommend.

Such an amazing Vet.  I had a pup who lost his way and i needed to see if he was Chipped..  Church Hill Veterinary Hospital came highly recommended.   My new friend and I came in to see if he was Chipped.   He was.  The staff called the company and found out my new friends name and who his family is!  We called his family and we got to rejoice their reunion!!  Thank you for being so supportive!  Leo is home now!
I like this place so much

Jeff and the team took care of my two girls (dogs) for my stay in San Antonio. Jeff was always extremely professional, the team would go above and beyond to reach deadlines & hit all points that we've requested of them. Great communication, punctuality, and care. Thank you and always a pleasure Jeff!

-Gary
Amazing place to take your animals! Dr. Mauldin and his whole team are patient, wonderful caregivers. They also offer kenneling, and we’ve had nothing but good experiences there too.
Excellent!!
Take care of my German Shepards health and hygiene, very kind and knowledgeable
My cats likes it.
Very pet friendly! The aides, counter people, and vet, including the customers, seemed to enjoy being there. Reasonably priced too!
